column3: B1: decrypt condition uses single-valued StringEquals on multivalued kms:EncryptionContextKeys (fails closed, denies every Decrypt)
B2: CloudTrail advancedEventSelectors select DATA events for KMS; KMS crypto calls are management events, so trail misses them
M1: metric filter uses $.resources[0].arn lowercase; CloudTrail field is ARN (case-sensitive), filter never matches
M2: cloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn carries unmodified logGroupArn `:*` suffix (must be the bare logGroupArn)
M3: KMS error mapping inverted — unavailability fragments map to integrity error and vice versa (transient KMS trouble reads as tampering)
N1: dead VerifyMac/GenerateMac grants on symmetric ENCRYPT_DECRYPT CMK (MAC ops valid only on HMAC keys)
N3: openCustodyBlob lacks envelopeVersion gate — unsupported version accepted past KMS/AEAD use
N4: placeholder test (Match.objectLike typeof check) exists only to justify an import
